description: political-monitor daily run JSON used wrong field names in the 'counts' object: 'items_harvested' instead of 'total_items', 'shared' instead of 'shared_topics', and a flat structure instead of the nested 'by_lean' object the render script expects. This caused Items, Left, Right, Center, and Shared header stats to all render as 0.
correction: counts object must use: total_items (int), by_lean.left/right/center (ints), shared_topics (int), gap_left (int), gap_right (int). Match render.py line 132-133 exactly.
systemic_fix: Add a counts-schema validation step in render.py that raises a clear error if required keys are missing, and document the required counts schema in the run JSON spec (specs/political-monitor.md).
